subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 1: Undefined and Defined Terms
description: Model and name foundational geometric objects: points, lines, planes, rays, segments, and angles.
learningObjectives: Distinguish undefined terms from defined geometric terms
Model points, lines, and planes using diagrams and real objects
Name and draw rays, segments, and angles using correct notation
Use geometric notation such as line AB, ray AB, segment AB, and angle ABC accurately
Identify common notation mistakes in diagrams and written descriptions
prerequisites: Recognize basic flat shapes and straight edges
Use letters to label points in a diagram
Understand that a ruler can model a straight path
Read simple mathematical symbols and labels
